title: A new version of the Gene Finder is now available
bodyHtml:
This page previously displayed the Gene Finder, a tool that allowed you to specify a set of traits and retrieve the list of genes associated with those traits as illustrated in the diagram below.

 

 

We've now updated the Gene Finder so that it retrieves much more information and allows you to filter by multiple criteria:

 

 

The Gene Finder has expanded so much that we've re-named it the Gene Sifter. Find all the details on this help page. Because it's still in development, you'll find the new Gene Sifter under the KP Labs menu in the upper menu bar. Try out the new Gene Sifter here!

Open Gene Sifter
